long_biography.plain_text:
Roland Peralta brought experience from the fashion industry to Nutrafol, which he developed with Giorgos Tsetis and Sophia Kogan. The founders put nearly all their initial capital into a production run that went wrong when its capsules acquired an unexpected taste. They recovered usable ingredients, tested them and remade the batch. Peralta's work centred on the botanical and clinical approach behind the hair supplements.

Before Nutrafol's majority sale, he had also developed Kama Flight, a movement-based practice for partners. He has since established Magnificent Ventures to invest in health and longevity ventures, while directing Rain Dance Ventures as his family office. Kama Flight continues to offer partner classes and teacher training.
